tactics:
induction xs with
  | nil => simp [h]
  | cons hd tl ih => cases hp : p hd <;> simp_all [List.splitOnP_cons]

induction xs with
  | nil => simp [List.splitOnP_cons, List.splitOnP_nil, h]
  | cons hd tl ih => by_cases hp : p hd <;> simp_all [List.splitOnP_cons] <;> cases hs : List.splitOnP p tl <;> simp_all [List.splitOnP_ne_nil]
